scripts.db:reset:local: npm run db:apply:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:apply:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply my-miracles-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:apply:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply my-miracles --env production --remote
scripts.test: npm run db:verify && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
